title: Bygone Effigy
move_pattern: Starts asleep. Wakes on first turn (applies 10 Strength). Then repeatedly uses Slashes.
notes: Monster begins the encounter asleep. Upon its first turn, it wakes and gains 10 Strength, also triggering the elite second phase music (on non-test runs). After waking, it cycles exclusively through Slashes. SLEEP_MOVE_2 is defined in the state machine but is unreachable during normal combat.
